bootstrap: 2500 class-stratified subject-clustered resamples, same subject multiplicities across all five repeats and minutes; fixed predictions and no model refitting
classification: Original SVM hard prediction; no threshold tuning or calibration
cross_release_identity: Unknown; no pooling and no cross-release transfer in this experiment
inner_selection: 3-fold stratified CV balanced accuracy using only outer-training first-minute vectors
outer_assessment: 5-fold stratified CV x 5 repeats; each recording tested once per repeat
release_handling: Completely separate training, tuning, and testing by release
temporal_state_rule: stable-correct if all five predictions correct; stable-wrong if all five wrong; otherwise unstable
